Use.name: New Year's Day
Use.as: Restoration Day of the Independent Czech State

Rule.name: fixed-may-08-cz
Rule.comment: Den vítězství. Marks the end of the Second World War in Europe on 8 May 1945.

Rule.name: fixed-jul-05-cz
Rule.comment: Den slovanských věrozvěstů Cyrila a Metoděje. Honors the Byzantine missionaries who brought Christianity and the Glagolitic script to the Slavs.

Rule.name: fixed-jul-06-cz
Rule.comment: Den upálení mistra Jana Husa. Commemorates the burning at the stake of the religious reformer Jan Hus on 6 July 1415.

Rule.name: fixed-sep-28-cz
Rule.comment: Den české státnosti. Feast of Saint Wenceslas, patron saint and symbol of Czech statehood, killed on 28 September 935.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-28-cz
Rule.comment: Den vzniku samostatného československého státu. Marks the founding of Czechoslovakia on 28 October 1918.

NotableDate.name: Struggle for Freedom and Democracy Day

Rule.name: fixed-nov-17-cz
Rule.comment: Den boje za svobodu a demokracii. Commemorates the student demonstrations of 1939 and 1989 against totalitarian rule.
